cmd: Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object Manufacturer, Model, TotalPhysicalMemory | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption, Version, BuildNumber, OSArchitecture, FreePhysicalMemory | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, AdapterCompatibility, DriverVersion, AdapterRAM)
